segments.content:
Reignition of the Verdant Years Chapter 38 A Girl's Little Thoughts

August 24th, Sunday morning.

Ying Zhicheng woke up bright and early in his house near the company, got up, washed up, and dressed.

When he went out, the driver had already parked the car at the entrance, having waited for a long time.

Ying Zhicheng got into the car, and after it started and was driving smoothly, he asked, "What's the schedule for today?"

The secretary beside him was already prepared and reported to Ying Zhicheng, "President Ying, as per your instructions, you are returning to Yinjiang District this morning to take your daughter to register for the new school term."

"Previously, Ms. Yuan Wanqing contacted the company to discuss her comeback. Coincidentally, she has been living and recuperating in Yinjiang District, so you will be having lunch with her at noon."

"Around two in the afternoon, you will return to the company to preside over the promotional meeting for an upcoming TV series, as well as the follow-up album promotions for two artists, planning their roadshows and variety show schedules."

"Around five in the evening, you have dinner with the deputy director of the TV station at Langzhu Courtyard in Binhai District..."

On the way from the city center to Yinjiang District, half an hour passed as Ying Zhicheng listened to the day's schedule and the secretary's report on the progress of various specific matters. By then, the car had already arrived at the entrance of the Bihai Lanting residential complex.

"You two can find a place to rest this morning, no need to follow me." Ying Zhicheng got out and said to the driver and secretary in the car, "Come pick me up at the restaurant when Yuan Wanqing calls at noon."

"Understood, President Ying."

Walking into the residential complex, Ying Zhicheng found Building 12, Unit 1, pressed the doorbell at the entrance, entered the building, and took the elevator up to the door of 1502.

At this moment, the main door was wide open. Li Guohong, sitting on the living room sofa, waved at Ying Zhicheng and said with a smile, "You're here? It must have been a hassle for you to come all this way so early in the morning."

"It's Chanxi's school registration, I had to come." Ying Zhicheng walked over to the sofa and sat down. "Besides, I'm meeting someone nearby anyway, so it's not a problem."

As he said this, Ying Zhicheng looked toward the small hallway.

Lin Xiuhong was standing at the master bedroom door, listening to Li Luo and Ying Chanxi's explanation.

"Don't worry, Auntie Lin. I've already set a password for the computer. He'll have to get my permission every time he wants to use it." Ying Chanxi patted her chest in assurance. "From now on, I won't let him play on the computer until he's finished his homework."

"That's right, that's right," Li Luo chimed in from the side.

"Of course I trust Chanxi." Lin Xiuhong glanced sideways at her own son, then said, "But why not let Chanxi sleep in the master bedroom? You're a grown man, how can you have the nerve to occupy such a nice room?"

Hearing his mother say this, the corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched twice as he thought to himself, *Am I your biological son, or is Ying Chanxi your biological daughter?*

"It's okay, Auntie Lin." Ying Chanxi said, hugging Lin Xiuhong's arm. "I feel more secure in a smaller room."

"Besides, the bathroom outside is also used by Senior Xu next door. It's more convenient for the two of us girls to share one."

"Otherwise, if Li Luo and Senior Xu shared a bathroom, it would be a bit inconvenient at times."

After hearing Ying Chanxi's considerate words, Lin Xiuhong patted her head even more affectionately. "Chanxi, you're just too sensible. Li Luo, you brat, you'd better watch it. Be considerate of her, and if you dare bully Chanxi, just see how I'll deal with you."

Li Luo leaned against the hallway wall, folded his arms, and sighed. "I know, I know. Now that your inspection is more or less done, can we set off? Uncle Ying is already here."

"Mmm..." Lin Xiuhong nodded and didn't say much more. She turned, walked back to the living room, greeted Ying Zhicheng on the sofa, and then said, "Shall we get going then? It's already half-past eight."

"Senior, we're off to school to register," Ying Chanxi said, knocking on Xu Youyu's door.

"Mmm..." Xu Youyu responded drowsily from under her covers, not forgetting to add, "Happy first day of school. I'm going back to sleep."

Last night, to celebrate the upcoming school term, Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu had bought a lot of groceries, and Li Luo had cooked a grand feast.

For the occasion, Xu Youyu had even taken out some beer she had stashed away in her bedroom, cheerfully pouring a small cup for Li Luo and Ying Chanxi to try.

She, on the other hand, gulped down two cans. After they finished eating, chatting, washing the dishes, and cleaning up, it was already past ten at night.

Fueled by the alcohol, Xu Youyu then stayed up writing until two or three in the morning. She was exhausted now, so she didn't get up to see them off.

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi slung on their backpacks and, surrounded by their parents, embarked on their journey to school.

While chatting on the way, Ying Chanxi said, "You guys will probably be electing class committee members today. You could try running for class monitor."

"Are you nuts? Me run for class monitor?" Li Luo shook his head repeatedly. "Why are you telling me this?"

"What do you mean, nuts?" Ying Chanxi glared at him. "I'm the class monitor of Class One right now, you know. What are you trying to say?"

"Ahem." Li Luo coughed twice. "What I mean is, my abilities are insufficient for the position of class monitor. I'd better not go and make a fool of myself."

"But during military training, the class monitor is the class's correspondent," Ying Chanxi said with a blink. "While others are standing at attention, we might be in a meeting, listening to the teacher announce activities, or arranging schedules and important notices."

"There's a perk like that?" Li Luo raised his eyebrows.

"Yep," Ying Chanxi nodded. "When we were out buying groceries yesterday, Senior Xu told me about it. She's the class monitor for Class One of the second years, and she said she got to rest for a good portion of the military training."

"I see." Li Luo nodded. "I'm suddenly feeling that although my abilities may be lacking, one must always strive to better oneself."

Hearing him say this, Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes. "I'm just letting you know. After all, even if you want the position, you might not get it."

"We'll see when the time comes," Li Luo replied casually.

In truth, even with the perk during military training, Li Luo still didn't really want to be the class monitor.

After all, a class monitor was just an errand runner for the head teacher, with no real power to speak of. It was truly a thankless job.

But for Ying Chanxi, her thoughts were simpler.

She purely felt that if Li Luo became the class monitor, it could, on one hand, train his abilities, so he wouldn't always sound so flippant when he spoke.

On the other hand, whether it was during military training or in the day-to-day of school life, the class monitors from each class would be gathered for meetings from time to time to be notified of various matters.

This way, even though they weren't in the same class, they could at least see each other a few more times.

Ying Chanxi secretly glanced at Li Luo beside her and couldn't help but sigh inwardly.

If she had known this guy could get into No. 1 High, she wouldn't have participated in its independent admission program. If she had just taken the high school entrance exam, they might have even been placed in the same class.

Back when she was at Yucai Middle School, Ying Chanxi had already lost count of how many times she had refused the invitation to transfer to an honors class.
